public.note: Brokerage + Roth IRA. base = everything deposited minus withdrawn, up to and including base_through.

fidelity.note: 401(k). base = all contributions (yours + employer match) minus withdrawals, up to and including base_through.

merrill.note: ESPP + Visa equity plan. Uses the holdings' cost basis (ESPP purchase price, RSU value at vest), so no base is needed.
